methodology.Fees: Taker fees computed as Θ × C × p × (1 - p), where C is contracts and p is trade price. Θ = 0.0695 from 11:59 PM ET 2026-09-16, Θ = 0.06 from 12:00 AM ET 2026-07-01, Θ = 0.05 from 2026-04-04, flat 1% from 2026-01-09 to 2026-04-03. Combo trades (launched 2026-08-11) use the same formula until 11:59 PM ET 2026-09-24, then pay C × p × [Θ × (1 - p) + 0.04 × (1 - p)^4], with 0.04 raised to 0.06 from 10:00 AM ET 2026-10-01. Revenue breakdowns are not available due to lack of per-trader volume data.
methodology.UserFees: Taker fees computed as Θ × C × p × (1 - p), where C is contracts and p is trade price. Θ = 0.0695 from 11:59 PM ET 2026-09-16, Θ = 0.06 from 12:00 AM ET 2026-07-01, Θ = 0.05 from 2026-04-04, flat 1% from 2026-01-09 to 2026-04-03. Combo trades (launched 2026-08-11) use the same formula until 11:59 PM ET 2026-09-24, then pay C × p × [Θ × (1 - p) + 0.04 × (1 - p)^4], with 0.04 raised to 0.06 from 10:00 AM ET 2026-10-01. Revenue breakdowns are not available due to lack of per-trader volume data.
